sources.title: Plaso: creating a timeline
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Timesketch：假說、反證與可追溯故事
related.titleEn: Timesketch: hypotheses, counterevidence and traceable narratives
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付原始事件CSV、UTC校正公式、偏移證據與可確定或不確定的先後表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver original event CSV, UTC correction formula, offset evidence and certain-versus-uncertain ordering.
related.difference: 每個故事主張連到事件ID與來源，將支持、矛盾與未知證據分欄，避免只收集支持說法的事件。
related.differenceEn: Link each narrative claim to event IDs and sources, separating supporting, contradictory and unknown evidence to avoid confirmation bias.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: UTC=當地時間−時區偏移−已知時鐘超前量；不同來源的時間精度與語意不可忽略。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 事件A記14:30:00、時區UTC+8，主機時鐘快90秒；事件B可信UTC時間06:29:10。 A校正UTC為06:28:30，較B早40秒；未校正會錯認A晚50秒。
有佐證主張率=至少有獨立佐證的主張/所有主張；事件多不一定代表獨立來源多。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成故事有18個主張，12個有獨立佐證，3個被證據反駁，3個仍未知。 有佐證主張率12/18=66.6667%；反駁與未知合計6項不能寫成確定事實。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: UTC=local time−timezone offset−known clock lead; retain source precision and timestamp semantics. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Event A records 14:30:00 in UTC+8 on a clock ninety seconds fast; event B has trusted UTC time 06:29:10. Corrected A is 06:28:30 UTC, forty seconds before B; without correction A appears fifty seconds later.

Corroborated-claim rate counts claims with independent support; many events do not necessarily mean many independent sources. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic narrative has eighteen claims: twelve independently supported, three contradicted and three unresolved. Corroborated-claim rate=66.6667%; the six contradicted or unresolved claims cannot be stated as facts.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NIST整合桌上演練：從警示到復原驗收
related.titleEn: NIST integrated tabletop: from alert to recovery acceptance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付原始事件CSV、UTC校正公式、偏移證據與可確定或不確定的先後表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver original event CSV, UTC correction formula, offset evidence and certain-versus-uncertain ordering.
related.difference: 制定學習目標、角色、注入卡、停止條件及評估表，讓每次決策都留下證據與未決事項。
related.differenceEn: Define objectives, roles, inject cards, stop conditions and evaluation criteria, recording evidence and unresolved questions at each decision.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: UTC=當地時間−時區偏移−已知時鐘超前量；不同來源的時間精度與語意不可忽略。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 事件A記14:30:00、時區UTC+8，主機時鐘快90秒；事件B可信UTC時間06:29:10。 A校正UTC為06:28:30，較B早40秒；未校正會錯認A晚50秒。
演練達標率=具備證據的達標目標/預先定義目標；完成劇情不等於全部能力已驗證。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 演練有10個目標：證明驗證2、分流2、保全2、復原2、溝通2；首輪7個有證據達標。 首輪達標率7/10=70%；三個缺口分別要有原因與補測。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: UTC=local time−timezone offset−known clock lead; retain source precision and timestamp semantics. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Event A records 14:30:00 in UTC+8 on a clock ninety seconds fast; event B has trusted UTC time 06:29:10. Corrected A is 06:28:30 UTC, forty seconds before B; without correction A appears fifty seconds later.

Exercise attainment counts evidenced objectives over predefined objectives; finishing the story does not validate every capability. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Ten objectives cover two each for provenance, triage, preservation, recovery and communication; seven have evidence in the first round. First-round attainment=70%; each of three gaps needs a reason and retest.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
